dct_description_sm: The goal of the research is to study the relationship between structure and function in the different habitats of a site (Stordalen Mire) near Abisko, Sweden where permafrost is thawing. Relationships between water table, vegetation and microtopography were established on 2 spatial scales (plot and site level). Decomposition rates, CO2 and CO4 fluxes were also measured in habitats along the permafrost thaw gradient
dct_title_s: Structure and function of the plant communities of a thawing permafrost peat plateau
